body.message:
Dear Afifa,

We would like to inform you that the matter has now been formally escalated to the Dubai Economy & Tourism (DET) under case reference DM-15895.

All supporting documentation, including your confirmation of the refund and the agreed 14 working day timeline, has been submitted.

As of today, the refund remains outstanding and significantly overdue.

We kindly request that the full amount of AED 17,675 be processed immediately in order to resolve this matter amicably before further escalation.

If the refund is not completed promptly, we will proceed through DET and other available channels without further notice.

We look forward to your confirmation of the transfer.

Best regards,  
Mikhail Kantsavenka
